questions.question: An isosceles triangle has a top angle of 40°. Find the base angles, giving reasons.
questions.expected_answer: Base angles are equal (isosceles triangle). Angles in a triangle add to 180°, so the base angles share 180° − 40° = 140°; each is 70°.

questions.question: A kite has a top angle of 80°, a bottom angle of 60° and two equal side angles. Find each side angle and explain why quadrilateral angles add to 360°.
questions.expected_answer: (360° − 80° − 60°) ÷ 2 = 110°. A diagonal splits a quadrilateral into two triangles, so its angles add to 2 × 180° = 360°.

questions.question: A rectangle has a perimeter of 50 cm and a length of 15 cm. Find its width.
questions.expected_answer: Opposite sides are equal: 50 − 2 × 15 = 20, so the width is 20 ÷ 2 = 10 cm.
